purpose: Increase Monte Carlo permutation resolution and independently re-seed the synthetic null-family experiment after the exploratory v0.1.3 run. This is a follow-up benchmark and not independent external replication.

null_test_design.correction: Holm step-down within each predeclared family of three null hypotheses

non_claims: This rerun does not establish external independent replication.
The bundled UCI Wine dataset remains one real dataset; its split changes with the seed but it is not a second dataset.
Synthetic null calibration does not establish performance on arbitrary real-world distributions.
No real-data anomaly precision/recall is claimed because verified anomaly labels are absent.
No KeyMatrix runtime integration or promotion is authorized.
